name: attachments-list-en
query: Which files are attached to invoice {credit_docnum}?
expected_behavior: Resolves the invoice by DocNum with a live query and reads its AttachmentEntry
If AttachmentEntry is set, queries Attachments2 for that entry and lists file names with extensions; if it is empty, says the invoice has no attachments
Does not try to upload, attach, or write anything
Does not show server folder paths as something the user can open
